utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard they’re hoping to gather folks and supplies by Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Saturday, really? Are you sure that’s the deadline?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s what I heard from Marla at the corner shop, but I wouldn’t swear on it—might be worth checking with the organizers.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right, so we’re still on for the repair drive Saturday morning, and I’ll remind the others too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — Saturday morning works for me. Thanks for reminding everyone.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll keep nudging the others and we’ll meet Saturday morning for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What’s the repair drive need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly tools and a few hands to sort donations. I heard they’re especially short on screwdrivers, tape, and people who can carry boxes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can bring a set of screwdrivers and packing tape. I can also help carry boxes for an hour—what time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive — what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — I’m keeping track of supplies, so we could use screws, duct tape, and a few work gloves. If you can bring any of those, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves. I’ll drop them off before the drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time works best for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: After school on Saturday would work best for me—maybe around 10 a.m.?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 10 a.m. works for me—I’ll check the school calendar and let a few other parents know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m in, Oren — just tell me the time and what needs fixing. I like a clear plan, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, thank you — I’m pretty sure we’re starting at 10 on Saturday. Mostly the loose fence panel and that stubborn porch light, if I’m remembering it right.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday at 10 works for me, Oren. I’ll bring my basic tools and we’ll start with the fence panel, then the porch light.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive sounds great — I can help spread the word and bring a few neighbors by too!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn — that helps. I just want to make sure we’ve got enough tables and room for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Pia — I’ll ask folks to let me know if they’re coming and whether they can lend a table, so we don’t get surprised.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive, but I’m happy to help if you can point me in the right direction.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, thank you, Nell — that would be wonderful. We’re collecting broken small appliances and bikes at the community room on Saturday morning, and I could really use help checking people in and labeling items.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds manageable, Rosa. I can come by Saturday morning and help with check-in and labels—what time should I arrive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I help, can you remind me what needs repairing for the drive and when it’s happening?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I don’t have the full list with me right now, but I can check and get you the repair details and date. Thanks for helping out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — send me the details and date when you have them, and I’ll see where I can help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little with the repair drive, though I may need to keep it brief today.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli — even a little help is plenty. I’m running a bit behind as usual, but I can catch up and take whatever small task needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s kind of you, Dane. I can sort a few supplies or help for a short while, then I’ll need to head out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mina, I’ve got a few spare tools I can bring for the repair drive—anything in particular you think folks will need most?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes—do you have a drill, a set of screwdrivers, and some duct tape? If so, bring those first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely—I’ve got a drill, screwdrivers, and duct tape, and I’ll bring those first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping track of the repair drive—where are we meeting up?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I think we’re meeting by the community shed, but I only skimmed the note—can you double-check the time?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure—I’ll double-check the note for the time. The community shed sounds like the meetup spot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Rey, I’m happy to help with the repair drive—I've got a couple toolboxes and a folding table we can use.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. That’ll really help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Glad to help — I can bring them by whenever you need. Just let me know what time to show up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the timing and what needs to be brought so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Fair enough — so you need the timing and a clear list of what to bring before you can say yes, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, exactly — if I know the time window and the supplies needed, I can figure out whether I can commit without scrambling.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive — I can help connect folks who need tools with the people who have them. Just tell me where you want me to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be a huge help, Jules — could you start by matching people who need tools with folks who can lend them? I’ll keep track of the requests and loop you in as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, send the requests my way as they come in and I’ll start matching people with lenders. I’ll make sure everyone knows when and where to hand things off.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got for the repair drive. What are you still short on?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still short on a hammer and a few screws. If you’ve got any spare tape or gloves, that’d help too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the shed for a hammer, screws, tape, and gloves. If I find them, I’ll bring them over right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s getting a nice turnout this weekend. If you want, I can tell you what I’ve heard around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’d be great, thanks. I’m trying to work around the school schedule, so any details you’ve heard would help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — folks are saying the repair drive is set for Saturday morning, which should work better around the school day. I also heard they’re hoping for plenty of volunteers, so it may be busiest right after drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Rosa, I’m in for the repair drive—just send me the basics and I’ll handle my part.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Bo—thank you. I’ll send you the time, supply list, and your station assignment this afternoon so we’re all lined up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks Rosa—just the essentials and I’m good to go. I’ll watch for it this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Leo, I heard you’re organizing the repair drive—what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — I could use help sorting donated tools and checking what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can help sort the tools and make a list of what needs repairs. When should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, I’m putting the word out for the repair drive—if you know anyone who can lend a hand, send them my way. The more neighbors we rally, the better.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll ask around, Quinn—mostly I hear things second-hand, but I can pass the word along and send anyone interested your way.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Nell, that’s perfect—second-hand word travels fast around here. If anyone asks, tell them we need helpers of all kinds and I’ll fill them in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Eli, I’m helping keep track of where everything is for the repair drive—do you know where the tools and drop-off bins are being set up?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hi Opal. I haven’t heard the final setup plan yet, but I can check the notice board and ask around this morning.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Eli — that’d be a big help. Let me know where they land, and I’ll keep the locations noted.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hana, what time is the repair drive happening, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me confirm the time and the item list before I say for sure—I don’t want to guess.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Hana—please let me know once you’ve confirmed, especially if they need tools or spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Ira — I’d appreciate that. I keep forgetting the details, so a heads-up would really help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll ask around and let you know if I hear any repair drive updates.
